question: Only count completed orders.

priorTurns.question: How many orders came through each channel?
priorTurns.sql: SELECT o.Channel, COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderId) AS OrderCount FROM dbo.Orders AS o GROUP BY o.Channel ORDER BY o.Channel

referenceSql: SELECT o.Channel, COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderId) AS OrderCount FROM dbo.Orders AS o WHERE o.Status = 'Completed' GROUP BY o.Channel ORDER BY o.Channel
